text.tspan: Gray bars: the gap from the frozen primary model after the group label is shuffled across the 40 core names (within the other axis), 10,000
shuffles. Gray line: the gap between two random halves of names from the same group, 2,000 splits (10 names per half, so conservative; the 20 vs
20 shuffle is the like-for-like baseline). Blue line: the real gap. Same name averages as the confirmatory test; fixed seed. Descriptive; uses
checks fixed in the plan, not a new test.
